topic: 近半年智能体技术在具身智能行业的发展应用

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (medium): 智能体在具身系统中的新近表述分散在 agentic control、embodied reasoning、skill graph、memory、success detection 与 multi-agent collaboration，需要跨词族检索。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-agentic-robot-control
dynamic_suggestions.why: 直接覆盖以智能体为上层控制器的机器人系统。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-embodied-reasoning-tool-use
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"embodied reasoning" AND (all:"tool use" OR all:"tool calling" OR all:planning)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖高层推理、工具调用和技能选择。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robot-skill-graph-agent-os
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"skill graph" OR all:"agent OS" OR all:orchestration) AND (all:robot OR all:embodied)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖技能图、运行时编排和资源调度。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-embodied-agent-memory
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"embodied agent" AND (all:"episodic memory" OR all:"spatial memory" OR all:"working memory")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖长时任务中的经历记忆、空间记忆和工作记忆。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-success-detection-replanning
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"success detection" OR all:"failure detection") AND (all:robot OR all:embodied) AND (all:replanning OR all:retry)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 智能体闭环的关键不是计划生成，而是执行后判定、重试和重规划。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-multi-agent-robot-collaboration
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"multi-agent" OR all:"multi-robot") AND (all:"embodied intelligence" OR all:"robot manipulation") AND all:collaboration
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖多个物理智能体的协作、分工和无显式通信协调。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-agentic-robot-fragility
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:agentic OR all:"LLM agent") AND all:robot AND (all:fragile OR all:hallucination OR all:failure OR all:safety)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 主动寻找幻觉、误判成功、脆弱性和安全限制。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-agentic-industrial-deployment
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:agentic OR all:"physical agent") AND all:robot AND (all:industrial OR all:warehouse OR all:manufacturing) AND (all:deployment OR all:production)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖工厂、仓储和制造业中的智能体化机器人部署。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-agentic-robotics-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs 2026 (agentic OR embodied reasoning) robot planning memory
dynamic_suggestions.why: API 欠召回时发现 agentic robotics 新论文。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-physical-agent-industry-web
dynamic_suggestions.query: 2026 physical agent embodied reasoning robot deployment official
dynamic_suggestions.why: 校准产业界对 physical agent 与 embodied reasoning 的实际用法。

calibration_notes: arxiv calibration (high): 论文标题直接采用 Agentic AI for Robot Control。
arxiv calibration (high): 论文采用 Embodied AgentOS、3D spatial memory 和 executable skill graphs。
project-page calibration (medium): 产业模型采用 embodied reasoning、tool calling 与 success detection。
company-page calibration (medium): 产业系统采用 semantic reasoning、long-horizon autonomy 与 full-body control。
